༄༅/ /rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pa la gtor 'bul gyi rim pa khyer bde rig 'dzin dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pa la gtor 'bul gyi rim pa khyer bde rig 'dzin dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ye/ gtor ma la rnam gzhag mang ba las/ skabs 'dir rtag gtor yod na kha gso/ med dam yod kyang rung dus gtor dang rgyun gtor gang yin sman raka phud mchod dang bcas pa bsham/ de dag gang yang mi 'byor ba'i skabs su'ang phye mar dang phud mchod tsam la brten te/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros ye shes me rlung chus// gtor ma'i 'bags btsog dri ma bsregs gtor bkrus// rlung me thod sgyed steng du ka pā la// yangs shing rgya cher sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// rigs lnga yab yum sa bon 'bru bcus mtshan// me rlung sbyor bas ban+dha'i dam rdzas khol// ye shes bdud rtsi 'bru gsum rnam par bkug /'od zhu rnam par rtog pa'i nyes skyon sbyangs// ro bcud nus ldan bdud rtsi chen por rtogs// 'dod yon mchod sprin mkha' khyab sbar bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ thugs srog 'od kyi pho nyas rtsa gsum dang*// chos skyong gter srung dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams// mdun mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang mthun dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs// dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang bas mchod// sman gtor rak+ta zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud// rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi ye shes ljags// rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te bzhes su gsol// na mo sarba rat+na gu ru i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gcig gam gsum skabs sbyar/ na mo/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud// gang zag snyan brgyud las 'phro gter gyi brgyud// mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs zad sar phyin// 'dun pa sems dang rigs chen 'byed pa dang*// dbugs phyin lung chen thob dang rtsal chen rdzogs// rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun grub kyi// sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang/ khyad par dkon mchog spyi 'dus gu ru rje// sku gsum sku lnga mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs tshogs// gter chen gter phran las can chos bdag la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// rdo rje 'chang chen gdod gnas grub chen brgyad// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs// rgyud sde bzhi yis mchog thun grub rnams dang*/

khyad par te lo nā ro mar mi dwags// che bzhi chung brgyad shangs pa bka' brgyud dang*// bka' gdams lam 'bras sbyor drug zhi byed gcod// bsnyen sgrub la sogs bshad sgrub srol 'dzin pa'i// rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// byang chub bar du thugs rjes mi 'dor bar// ye shes mchog gis bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sman gtor rak+ta zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi ye shes ljags// phyag mtshan sbu gus drangs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ de ba ga ṇa shān+ta kro dha sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bde gshegs zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang*// 'bar ba khrag 'thung khro bo lnga bcu brgyad// tshogs chen 'dus pa theg dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha// sgyu 'phrul mnyam sbyor la sogs tan+t+ra sde// bco brgyad nas gsungs yi dam lha tshogs dang*// bla ma dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor tshom bu dgu// rta mchog rol pa yi dam dgongs 'dus lha// dmar nag me phreng gu ru drag tu khros// bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor pa// sku mchog 'jam dpal gsung mchog pad+ma dbang*// thugs mchog yang dag yon tan bdud rtsi'i rigs// phrin las phur pa rbod gtong ma mo dang*// dmod pa drag sngags 'jig rten mchod bstod lha// sgrub chen bka' brgyad zhi dang khro bo la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro drwa ba sdom// dgyes rdor mā ya sangs rgyas thod pa dang*// gdan bzhi rgyal ba rgya mtsho dam tshig sgrol// gsang 'dus 'jigs byed dgra nag gshed dmar po// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba mi g.yo phyag rdor sogs// pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med lha rnams dang*// dpal rtse rdor dbyings la sogs rnal 'byor rgyud// rnam snang mngon byang la sogs spyod pa'i rgyud// bde gshegs pad+ma rdo rje rgyas pa'i rigs// lngas rtsen nor bu can te bya rgyud kyi// lha tshogs yab yum sprul par bcas pa la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// phrin las bzhi dang grub pa chen po brgyad// phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol// sman gtor rak+ta zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi ye shes ljags// 'od kyi sbu gus drangs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ḍā ka ḍā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs// yul chen nyer bzhi gnas chen sum cu gnyis// dur khrod brgyad kyi dpa' bo ḍā ki dang*/ khyad par rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod dkar dmar rigs// dbyings phyug rnam dgu mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus/ khros ma nag mo seng ge'i gdong pa can// ku ru kul+le rje btsun sgrol ma yum// grub pa'i rgyal mo ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs// sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las// sna tshogs 'jig rten dam tshig sha za'i rigs// drug cu rtsa bzhi rigs brgya'i rnal 'byor ma// zhing sngags lhan cig skyes pa'i tshogs rnams la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// thig rlung dbang 'dus rten 'brel phyogs med 'char// 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /sman gtor rak+ta zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud// dam can chos skyong rnams kyi rdo rje'i ljags// mtshon cha'i sbu gus drangs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba dharma pa la sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ khrag 'thung rdo rje srin po tshogs kyi bdag /legs ldan nag po ljang sngon drag po dang*// bya rog mtshan can myur mdzad ye shes mgon// dpal mgon ma ning rdo rje gur mgon dang*// stobs 'phrog dbang po zhang blon a gho ra// stag zhon bing ma gri gug seng zhon dang*// las mdzad bdud mgon chen po trak+shad sogs// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las mgon po'i rigs// dur bdag yab yum rta nag dregs pa la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// smug nag khros ma sngags kyi bdag mo che// shan pa nag mo 'bar ma me yi gdong*// yum chen dpal 'bar re ti mched de bzhi/ khrag 'thung dud sol ma dang dmag zor rgyal// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma gcig dpal lha mo// rab brtan ma dang rdo rje gshog rgod ma// bde chen rgyal mo zhi chags khros pa'i gar// spyang zhon ma dang sha za kha mo che// zhing skyong dur khrod ma mo 'khor bcas la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// rdo rje ber can lha mo rang byung ma// dbugs len bcu drug phyogs bcu skyong ba'i mgon// dregs pa don gnyis ma sring 'bar ma dgu

/dus bzhi'i lha mo dmag rgyal mched bzhi la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// srin mgon thod phreng dbang phyug yab dang yum// dmar po gyad chen 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal// shan pa dmar nag gza' mchog rā hu la// mgar ba dmar nag zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong*// rgyal chen sku lnga gnod sbyin tsit+ta dmar// rol pa rkya bdun rdo rje brag btsan la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// ce spyang ma brgyad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad// ging bdud rtsis pa 'chi bdag bye ba 'bum/ khams brgya dmus long khyi spyang 'brug mo brgyad// shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag skyes bu ging*// rje mo bcu bzhi sman mo lnga bcu brgyad// sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang*// phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang btags shing chags// gab sbas las myur mchog gi sde brgyad rigs// dregs pa rkya gsum dregs pa sde lnga sogs// gnas gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad srung zhing zlog /dgra bgegs byad ma thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlogs// bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod du dkar mngar bcud// 'dod rgu kun 'byung zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho// nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul ljags// rin chen sbu gus drangs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba yak+ṣa dzam bha la ba su pa ti sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras rigs chen brgyad// dpal gyi lha mo nor bdag grogs mo brgyad// dzam lha dkar ser dmar ljang nag po dang*// ku be ra sogs rta bdag chen po brgyad// 'brog gnas mched lnga ār+ya re man+ta// a par dzi ta tshogs bdag dkar ser dmar// gang mdzes nor dbang kun 'khyil mched de gsum// jo bo sngags kyi bdag po mi mgon dkar// don grub ser mo dge bsnyen ye shes grags// phag gdong mched lnga 'phrog ma bur bcas la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// snod bcud rgud pa zhi zhing dpal 'byor rgyas// tshe bsod dbang thang yar ngo'i zla ltar spel// gtor ma dkar mngar 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bcud// dpal mgon gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba'i ljags// 'od kyi sbu gus drangs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba lo ka pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lha klu gza' chen rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad// phyogs skyong 'jigs byed rgyal po chen po bzhi// dbang chen brtan ma 'byung lnga spar sme dang*// lo zla zhag dus phyogs mtshams sa yi bdag /dkar po brgyad cu a phyi mched lnga la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// sman btsun tshe ring mched lnga sprul 'khor bcas// brtan skyong ya ma bcu gnyis mthu chen bzhi// mgur lha bcu gsum srid pa'i lha chen dgu /gnyan chen thang lha smyo kha mkha' ri dang*// mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal sogs sprul bsgyur brgyad// rma rgyal spom ra sku rje seng chen rgyal// dge bsnyen nyer gcig yul 'di'i gzhi bdag la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// skyob pa'i lha lnga bsten pa'i lha dgu dang*// mi 'u gdung drug pha mtshun dgra bla'i tshogs// lung lnga ljongs gsum gling gcig sgrub gnas brgyad// gangs ra nyer gcig gnas chen nyer lnga sogs// gnas chen gnas phran srung zhing skyong rnams dang*// mdor na stong gsum dzam gling bod yul gyi// gnas yul gzhi bdag rigs chos rgyud srung la// dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// 'jin rten bde zhing bstan 'gro'i dge legs 'phel// rnal 'byor bsam pa 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod// mgron rigs kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las bcas la gus pas bstod par bgyi// nongs pa ci mchis chos dbyings klong du bshags// ye shes brtse ba chen pos bzod mdzod la// las dang dngos grub thogs pa med par stsol// rtag tu dgyes pas dgongs te phrin las mdzod// rtsa gsum nor lha rten la rtag tu bzhugs// 'jig rten pa rnams so so'i gnas su gshegs// 'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i snang ba yis// brtan g.yo kun khyab bkra shis dpal 'bar shog / ces pa 'di'ang sgrub brtson sde snod 'dzin pa phur bla karma mthu stobs nas bskul ngor/
dus mtha'i gtor ma'i slob dpon karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos tsa 'dra rin chen brag tu bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
